## About
Track Dog Racing is a Mazda Miata specialist on John B Sias Memorial Pkwy in Fort Worth. We carry suspension, superchargers, intercoolers, clutches, exhausts, roll bars and brakes, and we install and service them too.
We're not just a parts dealer. Everyone here owns a Miata, and we like to get our hands dirty. We only recommend parts we'd be happy running on our own cars.
The head dog, Gary Shuhart, studied industrial engineering at Texas A&M and started designing parts for his own Miata before putting them into production. He has a soft spot for yellow cars and will happily talk MotoGP or vintage racing with you.

## Services
- Products for Mazda's roadsters: Suspension, superchargers, intercoolers, clutches, exhausts, roll bars and brakes for your Miata.
- Installation: We put the parts on, so the upgrade you buy actually changes how your car drives.
- OEM parts and mechanical repairs: One reviewer came to us for OEM parts, aftermarket parts and repairs on a Miata that needed some care.

## FAQ
Q: Do you ship parts outside Texas?
A: Yes. We ship all over the world. US customers can see shipping rates in the cart by entering a zip code, and international customers can see rates during checkout.

Q: What should I tell you when I call or email?
A: Your Miata's year and any specifics like engine displacement or forced induction, plus part numbers for anything you're interested in.

Q: How do you pick the parts you sell?
A: We only recommend parts we'd be happy using on our own cars.
